wants.topic: Covert Military Operations & Intelligence Victories (e.g., 1971 Naval Ops, Pokhran Nuclear Test)
wants.evidence: DocoHidden's Operation Jackpot 1971 achieved 213.01x normal views and Operation Shakti reached 27.34x normal views. Tactical 2D animated breakdowns of Indian military heroism hugely outperform baseline content.

wants.topic: Nostalgic Social History & Daily Life 100 Years Ago (e.g., weddings, festivals, lifestyle in colonial India)
wants.evidence: Unknown Itihaas saw massive virality with ancient wedding culture (22.83x vsNormal) and 1926 Diwali celebrations (7.55x vsNormal), outperforming standard political history.

wants.topic: Evolutionary & Origin History of Indian Social Systems (e.g., origins of caste, reservation, human evolution)
wants.evidence: Aakash Tatawat's 'Human Evolution' hit 294.8x vsNormal and 'How Caste System Formed' hit 139.46x vsNormal, proving massive interest in long-form timeline origin stories.

wants.topic: High-Emotion Heroic Sacrifices & Tragedies of the Freedom Struggle (e.g., Bhagat Singh, Jallianwala Bagh, Partition)
wants.evidence: Har Mod Ki Kahani's Bhagat Singh full trajectory video achieved 10.4x vsNormal and Jallianwala Bagh got 7.37x vsNormal; Unknown Itihaas's 1947 Partition got 6.03x vsNormal.
